content.comment_body: Hello, Is there any method to keep the screen backlight of a [product_name] [article_no] continuously on, similar to when pressing buttons like ESC or OK? Currently, it's difficult to read the information on the [product_name] display due to its placement in the panel. Thank you.

Hello, For devices of the 4th series, it is not possible to keep the screen illuminated permanently. If there is a spare output available, you might consider connecting an external indicator lamp. Alternatively, try using the HI block along with a text block.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is experiencing poor readability on the [product_name] display due to its installation position and seeks to keep the screen backlight on at all times. It is clarified that this feature isn't available for the [version_no] series, affecting use in low-light or inaccessible locations. A suggested alternative is installing an external indicator lamp.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants the screen backlight on the [product_name] to stay illuminated permanently, improving readability in poorly lit environments or when the device is hard to reach, similar to the temporary lighting triggered by button presses.
